newsitem.title: UK: Controlled explosion at southern UK rail station.
newsitem.headline: Controlled explosion at southern UK rail station.

text.p: Bomb disposal experts on Wednesday carried out a controlled explosion on a suspect package at a railway station in southern England.
Lingfield station was closed after an unattended item was found. Police said they were still carrying out an investigation at the scene.
There was no immediate indication whether the package was innocent or a bomb.
The Irish Republican Army has disrupted road and rail links in England in this month with a series of hoax calls and a small number of bombs.
Five rail stations in central London were closed and three international airports were also disrupted by hoax bomb scares on Monday.
